Prebunking at Platform Scale: A Field Experiment
Delacroix, Ibarra & Chen — fabricated source document for the
SlopChecker test corpus.

Across four platform cohorts, prebunked participants retained roughly
sixty percent of their measured effect at the final follow-up. The
follow-up was conducted eight weeks after the final exposure, using
the same instrument as the baseline wave. Retention did not differ
significantly by cohort age or platform tenure.
